data.exact_reserve_text: The underwriting profit of GBP 12.0m in 2014 (2013, loss of GBP 27.4m) includes a release from prior year reserves of GBP 10.6m (2013, GBP 4.4m deterioration).
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2014 gross claims outstanding were GBP 349.134m. The report states the 2014 underwriting result "includes a release from prior year reserves of GBP 10.6m", indicating favourable development on prior years (net of reinsurance). Gross claims outstanding decreased to GBP 307.165m by 31 December 2014. No detailed gross prior-year-only movement figure is published in the technical provisions note, so the reported GBP 10.6m release (net) has been used as the best-available quantification.
raw_causal_phrases: includes a release from prior year reserves of GBP 10.6m (2013, GBP 4.4m deterioration).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure is provided in the notes. The only quantified prior-year figure is a narrative stating a release of GBP 10.6m; this appears to be a net (after reinsurance) amount and has been used as a fallback. The technical provisions reconciliation 'Movement in provision' line includes current-year movements and was therefore not used per instructions. Gross premiums are negative overall because reinsurance acceptances exceed direct written premiums in 2014; percentages are computed against the gross total (which is negative). No gross claims development triangle is present in the financial statements.
